prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Beryllium (Be) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a riverside seating area waiting for festival fireworks
Time of day: night under neon and signage light, coloured reflections.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a daily kebaya — a sheer embroidered fitted blouse over a batik sarong — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; head turned back over her own left shoulder — the shoulder on the image's left side; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a camera by its grip at her side; it is all she holds.
LEGS: paused mid-walk, weight on the front foot.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — beryllium: a light, very stiff steel-grey metal hidden inside beryl, the mineral that grows clear as green emerald and sea-blue aquamarine; found in 1798 by Vauquelin and first called glucinium because its salts taste sweet, though its dust is poisonous to breathe; freed as metal in 1828 by Wohler and Bussy using potassium; X-rays pass through it almost untouched; gold-coated hexagonal beryllium mirrors gather the first starlight in a great space telescope — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: Authorized QA and ordinary main publication; preserve generated outputs without exposure-based regeneration.

observations: 1024×1536; one adult woman in focus; selected world image attached as the sole reference.
Visible limbs join naturally; no extra or disconnected arm or leg observed. Fingers in grips or clasped hands partially overlap.
Aquamarine hair and green eyes retain the selected character identity; no armour or crown reused.
Body faces three-quarters toward the camera rather than rear three-quarter; firework bursts are not clearly shown.
qa.cause: Generated output deviates from the scene/crop/hand instruction as described.
